paite: Huan Sabbath ni abei in han ah Mari Magdalin, Jakob nu Mari leh Salomite ava hoh ua, amah nuh ding in gimlim alei uhi.
heading: Jesu Thohnawnna / (Mat 28.1-8; Luk 24.1-12; Joh 20.1-10)
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

paite: Ni sagih ani masapen in, zingsangpi in, nisuah lai in han ava tung uhi.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

paite: "Han kong a suang kua'n hon khukkhiaksak ding adiam aw?" akichih laitak un,
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

paite: adak uleh suang khukkhiaksa in amuta uh, alian mahmah ngal a.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

paite: Han sung ah alut ua, pasal khat puanngou silh, ataklam pang a tu amu ua; lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

paite: Huchi in ama'n akiang uah, "Lamdang sa kei un; Jesu Nazaret mi, akilhden uh, na zong ua; athounawnta; hiai ah a-omta kei; en un, asialna uh!
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

paite: Himahleh pai unla, anungzuite leh Peter kiang ah, Galili gam ah na ma uah apai ding hi; na kiang ua achih bang ngei in huai ah na mu ding uh," achi hi.
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

paite: Huchi in linna leh lamdang sak luatna in amau atuam ziak in apawt ua, han a kipan atai vengveng ua; alauh ziak un kuamah kiang ah bangmah agen kei uhi.
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

paite: Huan ni sagih ni masapen zingsang a athohnawn in, Mari Magdalin, asung a pan dawi sagih adelhkhiakna nu kiang ah akilak masapen hi.
heading: Mari Magdalin Kiang A Kilakna / (Mat 28.9-10; Joh 20.11-18)
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

paite: Amah Jesu ompih zelte kiang ah ava hoh a, misi suun a akah lai un ava hilhta hi.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

paite: Himahleh amah ahing a, muh leng amu chih aza na ua, agingta tuan kei uhi.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

paite: Huai nung in alak ua mi nih gam lam zuan a apai lai un mel dang pu in akiang uah akilak nawn hi.
heading: Nungzui Nihte Kiang A Kilakna / (Luk 24.13-35)
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

paite: Amau nungzui dangte kiang ah ava hilh ua, amau thu leng agingta tuan kei uhi.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

paite: Huai nung in, an a-um lai un sawm-le-khatte kiang ah akilak a, athohnawn nung a amute thu agintak louh uh leh alungtang khauh thu uah ataihilh hi.
heading: Jesu Sawm-le-khatte Kiang A Kilak / (Mat 28.16-20; Luk 24.36-49; Joh 20.19-23; Nas 1.6-8)
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

paite: Akiang uah, "Khovel tengteng ah pai unla, thilsiam tengteng kiang ah tanchinhoih hilh un.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

paite: Agingta a baptisma tang hotdam in a-om ding a; agingta lou tuh siam louh tang in a-om ding.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

paite: Hiai chiamtehnate'n agingtate azui zel ding: Ka min in dawite adelhkhe ding ua, pau thak in apau ding uh;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

paite: khut in gulte ala ding ua; sihna gu bangchibang dawn mah le uh bangmah achi kei ding uh; damloute tung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua, adam zel ding uh," achi hi.
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

paite: Huchi in Toupa Jesu'n akiang ua thu agen khit in van ah pitouh in a-om a, Pathian taklam ah atu hi.
heading: Jesu Vankahna / (Luk 24.50-53; Nas 1.9-11)
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

paite: Huchi in amau apaikhia ua, gam teng ah thu agenta uhi. Toupa'n amau aseppih a, chiamtehnate'n zui in thu ahihkip zel hi. Amen.
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
